faqs.question: Do you provide Certificate of Analysis (COA) and MSDS with chemicals?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100% of our analytical reagents, acids, and HPLC solvents are accompanied by batch-specific COA and GHS-compliant Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS).

faqs.question: What are your delivery turnaround times across Pune?
faqs.answer: Local Pune deliveries (Sinhagad Road, Narhe, Dhankawadi) are dispatched within 60-90 minutes. Hinjawadi IT Park, Bhosari/Chakan MIDC, and Pune University receive same-day delivery when ordered before 2 PM.

faqs.question: Can colleges and university departments purchase via Purchase Orders (PO)?
faqs.answer: Yes, we work extensively with educational institutions including SPPU, COEP, and polytechnics with official institutional POs, GST tax invoices, and university billing protocols.

faqs.question: How can I get an immediate price quote?
faqs.answer: You can compile items using our website's RFQ Quote Cart, submit via our WhatsApp Enquiry button (+91 75909 071), or call our sales desk directly at 9096759191.
